6.1 The workmanship and finish of various tools shall be of best grade and to the entire satisfaction of users. 8.2 The brass parts shall be given light green finish. The aluminium parts shall be anodized and finished so that they do given light green finish. The steel and plastic parts shall also be suitably not reflect light into eyes while working. 7. Functional Requirements - The tools shall be so designed as to provide while working. 7.1 The movement of the feet of the tools on scribing surface shall be smooth, 7.2 The stability of the tools over the surface shall be adequate one side due to its own weight. 7.3 The swivelling arrangement shall function smoothly. 7.4 The needles and blades to the base material. shall cut the coating neatly so that adequate hand grip

the tool

does not fall on

and cleanly

without

causing

any damage

8. Tests - The scribing tools shall be tested to comply with the requirements specified under 4 and 5. 8.1 The scribing tools shall show no sign of damage, looseness of parts and missing parts. 8.2 The various tools shall be tested by actual working on a scribing sheet be confirmed. 8.3 The microscopes shall be tested for various parameters according to 8.4 The magnifiers shall be tested for various parameters according to IS 9.
